name: Chili Oil
siboNotes: Pure chili oil is FODMAP-free, but check ingredients for garlic or onion additions which would make it high FODMAP.
preparationTips: Make homemade by infusing neutral oil with chili flakes or whole dried chilies
Avoid commercial versions containing garlic or onion powder
Store in refrigerator to maintain freshness and prevent rancidity
Start with small amounts as tolerance varies with spice level
alternatives: Cayenne pepper mixed with olive oil
Red pepper flakes in neutral oil
nutritionalHighlights: Provides healthy fats from base oil
Contains capsaicin which may support metabolism
Fat-soluble vitamins if using quality base oil
